clips.title: The story
paras: With her knife recovered from Pretty Boy Duncan, Catelyn the Blade loans the troll artifact so it can be used against a sunken altar off the coast. Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay wants the Stone of the Tides for his collection of ancient troll artifacts.

Catelyn the Blade lends her recovered troll dagger to break an altar submerged deep beneath the waves. Though no expert on troll ruins like her father, she has heard of a sunken troll city, and she points toward it, out near the reef northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp. Within the underwater ruins of the Vile Reef, the Altar of the Tides rests, surrounded by a distinct blue glow amid sea life and murlocs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you're looking for an altar of some sort? Well, I'm no expert on troll ruins like my father, but I have heard about a sunken troll city out near that island you're looking for. Maybe you should try there.
You got my knife back for me, so I guess you can borrow it... But I want it back when you're done!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you retrieved the Stone of the Tides for me, friend? I've already cleared out a space and purchased a fine stand for it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Amazing! The Stone of Tides! It shall have a place of prominence in my collection of ancient troll artifacts. Did you see how it almost seems as though a tide is trapped within its surface? Magnificent!
